domain_hypothesis.reasoning: The dataset contains standard Human Resources metrics such as Attrition, EmployeeNumber, Department, JobRole, JobSatisfaction, MonthlyIncome, and WorkLifeBalance, indicating it is an HR employee demographic and retention dataset.

kpi_specs.name: Overall Attrition Rate
kpi_specs.description: Calculates the overall percentage of employees who have left the organization.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN Attrition = 'Yes' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS AttritionRate FROM data
kpi_specs.reasoning: A single card displaying the total attrition rate is the primary high-level metric for monitoring workforce stability.

kpi_specs.name: Attrition Rate by Department
kpi_specs.description: Measures the attrition percentage across different departments to identify areas of concern.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT Department, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN Attrition = 'Yes' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS AttritionRate FROM data GROUP BY Department ORDER BY AttritionRate DESC
kpi_specs.reasoning: A bar chart allows easy comparison of attrition rates across the department category to isolate high-risk groups.

kpi_specs.name: Average Monthly Income by Education Field
kpi_specs.description: Compares compensation averages across various employee educational backgrounds.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT EducationField, ROUND(AVG(MonthlyIncome), 2) AS AvgMonthlyIncome FROM data GROUP BY EducationField ORDER BY AvgMonthlyIncome DESC
kpi_specs.reasoning: Bar chart is effective for comparing a continuous metric (average income) across distinct categorical fields.

kpi_specs.name: Attrition Rate Trend by Years at Company
kpi_specs.description: Tracks how the likelihood of employee attrition changes based on their tenure in the organization.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT YearsAtCompany, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN Attrition = 'Yes' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS AttritionRate FROM data GROUP BY YearsAtCompany ORDER BY YearsAtCompany ASC
kpi_specs.reasoning: A line chart visualizes the trend of attrition rate as employee tenure increases, which helps identify critical years of tenure risk.

kpi_specs.name: Job Role Engagement and Retention Table
kpi_specs.description: Provides a comprehensive overview of headcount, average satisfaction, work-life balance, and attrition rates by job role.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT JobRole, COUNT(*) AS Headcount, ROUND(AVG(JobSatisfaction), 2) AS AvgJobSatisfaction, ROUND(AVG(WorkLifeBalance), 2) AS AvgWorkLifeBalance, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN Attrition = 'Yes' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS AttritionRate FROM data GROUP BY JobRole ORDER BY AttritionRate DESC
kpi_specs.reasoning: A multi-dimensional table is suitable for deep-diving into specific job roles to examine correlation between satisfaction metrics and attrition.
